major_cooldowns.name: Breath of Eons
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fly the shortest safe path that clips the boss hitbox and land the 10 second Temporal Wounds window on your allies' burst.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 403631 is both the cast and the player-side aura in the sampled parses; 409632 shares the name but was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Ebon Might
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Refresh it with no more than 3 to 4 seconds left on the buff, and recast it right after channeling Time Skip to fish for a Double-time crit.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 395152 is the cast id; 395296 is the player-side aura the rules read.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend it on a max rank Fire Breath, and with Time Skip talented cancel its buff with a macro so its cooldown starts at once.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at max rank inside Ebon Might, and drop to Rank 1 when Upheaval is ready or under 4 to 5 seconds remain on Ebon Might or Duplicate.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 357208 is the observed cast id; 382266 and 1283718 share the name but were not seen as casts, and 357209 is the enemy debuff.

major_cooldowns.name: Upheaval
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it at Rank 1 inside Ebon Might, and only uprank it when the wider radius picks up more enemies.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The guide cites 408092, which was not observed as a cast; 396286 is the id seen in casts in all five sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Skip
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it right after your first Fire Breath and Upheaval, then on cooldown while Temporal Burst is up and your other cooldowns are spent.

major_cooldowns.name: Nullsight
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire the trinket as soon as you land from Breath of Eons so its Mastery covers your buff window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use Mastery trinket cast in 2 of the 5 sampled parses; a different trinket carries a different id.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it at the start of your opener ahead of Ebon Might, and again when a later burst window lines up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The potion the sampled parses drank; another potion choice carries a different id, so zero casts is not an error.

rule.description: Keep Ebon Might up on the raid
rule.action: Refresh it just before it falls off and keep spending Eruption so Sands of Time extends it.

rule.description: Fire Breath only inside Ebon Might
rule.action: Hold the empower until Ebon Might is back up and build resources with your filler meanwhile.
Wait for Ebon Might before you empower so the cast extends the buff and sends Shifting Sands to buffed allies.
Bank your Essence while Ebon Might is down and dump it once the buff is back up.

rule.description: Spend Essence Burst before casting Chrono Flames
rule.action: Burn a stack with Eruption before you press your filler again.

rule.description: Prescience and Breath of Eons before the empowers
rule.action: Send double Prescience, then Breath of Eons, then Tip the Scales into a max rank Fire Breath and Upheaval.
